feasibility.reason: CCS1 is an established North American DC charging standard; implementable and contradicts nothing.

parent_fit.reason: Names the North American public-infrastructure inlet, directly serving US_MARKET_CHARGING.

unambiguity.reason: 'shall charge through a CCS1 inlet' can be read as exclusive or as 'at least one'; with NACS/SAE J3400 increasingly common in NA the intended scope is unclear.
unambiguity.suggestion: Rephrase as 'shall provide a CCS1 inlet for public charging' and state whether other inlets (e.g. J3400) are allowed.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by the region/na variant folder plus spelled-out bev condition - stronger than its bev-gated parent.

verifiability.reason: Inspectable/testable against the CCS1 standard (SAE J1772 combo).
